result.title: Learning Gaussian Process Priors with Linear Semigroups and Kinetic Regularisation
result.summary: We introduce a semigroup-based construction of Gaussian process (GP) priors. A linear semigroup transforms a source GP at $t=0$ into a prior at $t=1$, enabling computationally tractable regression. Linearity preserves Gaussianity, allowing us to characterise the evolution of the covariance and draw connections with optimal transport and convolution models. The semigroup is parametrised by its generator, which is learned through two competing objectives: the marginal likelihood encourages agreement with observations, while a kinetic-energy regulariser favours lower-energy trajectories and limits unnecessary mass displacement from the source GP. Experiments on independent GP draws show that, with sufficiently many training functions, the learned prior provides accurate predictions on held-out functions, while kinetic regularisation substantially reduces the energy of the generated trajectories without compromising prediction accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出用线性半群构造高斯过程先验：由生成元参数化，把 t=0 的源 GP 演化为 t=1 的先验，并以边际似然拟合观测、以动能正则约束轨迹能量；在独立 GP 采样上验证了预测与能量下降效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属 GP 理论、与视觉推理无关，但其「用生成元刻画状态演化、并用动能/质量位移正则约束轨迹」的目标形式可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新轨迹的正则化与先验塑形提供概念线索，可供核查。
